# Checkout designs (fixture, text description of 18 frames)

1. "Cart": items, subtotal, button "Checkout".
2. "Checkout - choose": buttons "Continue as guest" and "Sign in".
3. "Sign in" (shared component).
4. "Address - saved list": saved addresses, "Add new", "Continue".
5. "Address - guest form": name, phone, address fields, "Continue".
6. "Address - guest form error": inline errors on phone and pincode.
7. "Order summary": items, promo field, total, "Continue to payment".
8. "Promo applied": discount line visible.
9. "Promo invalid": message "This code isn't valid".
10. "Payment - choose method": Card, UPI, COD options.
11. "Payment - COD disabled": COD greyed out with text "Not available for orders above 10,000".
12. "Card form": card fields, "Pay".
13. "Card processing": spinner.
14. "Card failed": "Card declined by bank", buttons "Try again" and "Change method".
15. "UPI waiting": "Waiting for approval in your UPI app", countdown 5:00.
16. "UPI success" (merges into confirmation).
17. "Order confirmed": order number, "Track order".
18. "COD confirm": "Pay on delivery" summary, "Place order".
